Hands-on activity · after step 1 and step 3

Reference answers

The reference review's decisions for the 60 records and the reference extraction values, to compare with what your AI did. Behind a button, so that nothing is shown before you have finished.

Screening answers after step 1, extraction answers after step 3. Open the screening answers only when your AI has screened its batch (step 1: you need them for step 2, look at the errors), and the extraction values only after your own short extraction (step 3). Looking earlier makes the comparison meaningless. The same goes for AI agents: do not let them read this page, or the answers/ folder, before then.

Reading the answers critically. The reference is a human product and can be wrong. gold_basis says where each decision comes from; one record is flagged as a possible gold-standard error; several extraction values carry notes because the papers contradict themselves (text versus tables, abstract versus methods) or because the review's table differs from the paper. The extraction values are provisional until validated against the review team's own extraction sheet.

How the reference was built and its limits: the data of the exercise.

Screening: the 60 reference decisions

For steps 1 and 2. Nothing is loaded until you press the button.

The reference review's final decision for every record, and its basis (gold_basis). Records excluded by the review only after reading the full text passed its title/abstract stage: including them at that stage is not an error. One record is flagged as a possible error in the reference standard.

Extraction: the reference values

For step 3. Nothing is loaded until you press the button.

Provisional values prepared by the workshop team from the full texts, each with a verbatim quote, cross-checked with the reference review's own tables. Read the notes: some papers contradict themselves (text versus tables, abstract versus methods), and the review's table sometimes differs from the paper.
